bgm.name: FRLG Route 03 (Road to Cerulean City - From Mt. Moon)

parameters: \bI got my Voltorb at the abandoned\nPower Plant.
\bThe slope makes it hard to steer.
\bI leveled up my Pokémon, but it\nwon't evolve. Why?
\bThere's no getting rich quick in\nbattling kids.
\bYou can find good stuff lying\naround on Cycling Road.
\bThere's good money in picking them\nup and selling
\bI need to catch a few z's!
\bI'm mighty proud of my bod, kiddo.\nCome on!
\w[signskin]Even Pokémon of the same species\nand level grow at different rates.
\bBe ready to fight for your beliefs!
\w[signskin]Press the B Button to stay in place\nwhile on a slope.
\w[signskin]Don't throw the game, throw Poké\nBalls instead!
